head.text: PTC interrupt pulse (timer B shown; PTCB_CLOCK = CPU_CLK / 16)

foot.text: The selected counter bit drives nINTx_OUT low. On the next falling PTCB_CLOCK edge nINTx_OUT_DELAYED goes low and asynchronously clears the counter, which ends the pulse, and the edge after that releases the counter. INTCTRL triggers on the falling edge of vINT6A/6B, so each period produces one level-6 request; it is cleared by the acknowledge. Timer A counts the 32.768 kHz clock, but its pulse is also timed by PTCB_CLOCK.
